scope: BASIC route migration + actual frontend/backend preservation prompts; rich model remains Gemini pending separate decision
conclusion: New prompts reduce invented scenes and remove forced register conversion. Luna preserves original register more consistently in this sample. Gemini retains occasional register/nuance drift. Only BASIC is configured to Luna; keywords and rich provider remain Gemini.

manualExamples.before: Old Gemini invented stairs, stronger pain and a hot compress. Old Luna kept facts closer but changed 해요체 to 한다체 because the old frontend demanded it.
manualExamples.after: Both new models keep uncertain walking plan, no clinic visit, rest, and 해요체.
Both new models keep 한다체 and the refusal to turn the cup story into a life lesson.
Luna keeps neutral 두 장만 and 해요체 both repetitions. Gemini run2 uses regretful 두 장밖에 and switches to 않았습니다.
Luna preserves source register, negations, 3 entries with 2 remembered/1 unfamiliar, and no advice. Gemini run1 shifts much of the text to 합니다체; both runs add eating the reheated soup.
New unseen inputs retain no smell experienced, quoted speaker vs own belief, neutral short mood, unknown season/weather and no tears; Luna is more conservative in wording.
Gemini still adds a formal ending or immediate sleep in balanced prompts, which only received the tone-line correction; Luna keeps source wording closer.

basicLive.observation: Direct API requests captured from real changed frontend/backend handler preserve source register and numbers.

limits: Qualitative manual review by Codex; not independently blinded scoring.
Small synthetic sample; no private operational records.
Main paired test includes both the old and new actual client envelopes and backend system prompts, avoiding the earlier server-only limitation.
4096-token comparison cap; production BASIC route is configured for 8192 to avoid truncating longer valid input.
No medical prompt, quota policy, storage path, payment or production deployment changes.
PDF 2500 non-space character output requirement remains; long-input compression tension is pre-existing.
